_dropped.why: The real, evidenced relationship exists (ABS's Definitieve Districtsresultaten Achtste Algemene Volkstelling Vol I — Paramaribo-Wanica, same document as sr-wanica's edge) but sr-paramaribo's part_of is already sr-censo, making a dependency edge to sr-censo invalid (edge to own container). No other document-stated dependency to a different corpus node was found.

ABS Milieustatistieken 11th edition front matter names Ministry of LVV as agriculture data-provider, but LVV is not a corpus node and no specific citable LVV publication was found. ABS Bedrijvenstatistieken states sources are BETEL field surveys, with no agriculture-specific content.

ABS Environment Statistics front matter names Stichting Bosbeheer en Bostoezicht (SBB) as forestry data-provider, but SBB is not a corpus node and no specific SBB report was found to justify a new node.

ABS trade-statistics metadata (handelsstatistieken) is sourced generically to Ministry of Finance customs/ASYCUDA with no rice-specific breakdown or institution named; ABS Bedrijvenstatistieken has no rice/agriculture mention. No ADRON (rice research institute) citation found.

Checked Staatsolie investors page, the 2025 bond announcement, the TotalEnergies/Staatsolie FID press release, and Mayer Brown/Afreximbank financing press releases. All are financing-narrative pieces; none state a specific methodology/data dependency on another corpus report.

Staatsolie media center has no PSC/royalty-terms documents listed; the Savings and Stabilization Fund Law 2024 full text defines 'inkomsten uit natuurlijke hulpbronnen' citing royalties/dividends/taxes from a 'bedrijfsspecifieke mijnbouwovereenkomst' but does not cite a Petroleum Law or PSC document by name.

ABS's GDP publication index page has no methodology text in the crawlable page (PDF links only). IMF's 2026 Article IV report references 'Non-Natural Resource Real GDP' only as staff-estimate table footnotes with no stated calculation method or cited source report.

Fetched the Wet Minimumloon 2019 full text. Art. 3(1): set 'na verkregen advies van de Loonraad' (Wage Council advice); Art. 6(1): biennial review considering social/economic indicators, but no named report, index or corpus node is cited as the data source; Art. 6(4) delegates detail to a future decree.

Checked CBvS CPI metadata (no exchange-rate mention), CBvS international-reserves GDDS metadata (exchange-rate parities for reserve valuation sourced to DNB/IMF, not corpus nodes), CBvS BOP metadata, and CBvS's macroeconomic-statistics metadata index (no dedicated exchange-rate metadata PDF exists). No citable dependency found.
